hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A split at index i is valid if the sum of elements up to index i equals the sum of the remaining suffix.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Calculate the total sum first, then iterate through prefix positions tracking running sums.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Whenever twice the running prefix sum equals the total sum, increment the count of valid split positions.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```python
def maxValidSplits(nums: list[int]) -> int:
    total = sum(nums)
    running = 0
    splits = 0
    for i in range(len(nums) - 1):
        running += nums[i]
        if running * 2 == total:
            splits += 1
    return splits
```

complexity.notes: Single pass after computing total sum finds all valid split boundaries.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recomputing subarray sums per split takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) auxiliary space suffices with running accumulation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Derives prefix == suffix balance condition cleanly.
